flags.why: This is a current regional name for a familiar food ingredient, so 'rare' is misleading ([usage](https://nongthonmoi.gov.vn/Pages/Phu-Dien-duoc-mua-khuyet-378955.aspx)).
This word belongs primarily to literary storytelling rather than ordinary conversation.
'Pháp lí' means relating to law, not 'lawful' in the sense of permitted by law.
The entry omits the everyday meaning 'short-tempered', as in 'Tính anh ấy rất cộc'.
The entry omits the common verb meaning 'to captivate', which is not restricted to following an adjective ([definition](https://vi.wiktionary.org/wiki/h%C3%BAt_h%E1%BB%93n)).
flags.fix: verb | to captivate; to mesmerise — Giọng hát của cô ấy hút hồn người nghe. = Her singing voice captivates listeners.
